column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 to ISO/IEC 29100 Privacy Framework Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS classes and selected Annex A controls (notably A.5.34 protection of PII) and ISO/IEC 29100:2024 privacy-framework concepts (PII principal/controller/processor and the 11 privacy principles). Supports ISO/IEC 27701 PIMS implementations layered on the ISO 27001 ISMS.
